instruction: Engaging English quiz host, bright and clear at a natural pace. Give each answer option a distinct beat. No rushed delivery.
pronunciation: Burj Khalifa: BOORJ kha-LEE-fa. Dubai: doo-BYE. Petra: PET-ruh. Jordan: JOR-dun. Angkor Wat: ANG-kor WAHT. Cambodia: kam-BOH-dee-uh. Pisa: PEE-zuh. Vishnu: VISH-noo. Rushmore: RUSH-mor. Say 'Question one' to 'Question five' exactly as written. Numbers are written as words, read as written.

clips.text: Question one. Which city is home to the Burj Khalifa? A. Doha. B. Cairo. C. Riyadh. D. Dubai.
Option D is correct. Dubai. Burj Khalifa in Dubai is the world's tallest structure, standing eight hundred twenty-eight meters tall.
Question two. The ancient rose-red city of Petra is in which country? A. Syria. B. Turkey. C. Jordan. D. Lebanon.
Option C is correct. Jordan. Petra in Jordan is famous for its rock-cut architecture and is called the Rose City.
Question three. Angkor Wat is a famous temple complex in which country? A. Cambodia. B. Vietnam. C. Laos. D. Thailand.
Option A is correct. Cambodia. Angkor Wat in Cambodia was built in the twelfth century as a Hindu temple dedicated to Vishnu.
Question four. The Leaning Tower of Pisa is in which country? A. Portugal. B. Greece. C. Spain. D. Italy.
Option D is correct. Italy. The Leaning Tower of Pisa, in Italy, is the bell tower of Pisa Cathedral, leaning nearly four degrees.
Question five. Mount Rushmore, with four carved presidents, is in which US state? A. Montana. B. South Dakota. C. Wyoming. D. Colorado.
Option B is correct. South Dakota. Mount Rushmore in South Dakota shows the heads of Washington, Jefferson, Roosevelt and Lincoln.
